claims.quote: We’re closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all‑new Siri AI, it’s an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season.

claims.claim: Supply constraints and rising costs for advanced semiconductors, memory and storage are expected to intensify, creating pricing pressure on products.
claims.quote: Although most components essential to the Company’s business are generally available from multiple sources, certain components are currently obtained from single or limited sources.

claims.claim: The Company’s reliance on single‑source suppliers for custom components may limit its ability to meet demand if those suppliers cannot scale yields.
claims.quote: When a component or product uses new technologies, initial capacity constraints may exist until the suppliers’ yields have matured or their manufacturing capacities have increased.

claims.claim: A judgment: Diversify the component supply base where feasible to reduce exposure to single‑source shortages and mitigate margin pressure.
claims.quote: The Company’s reliance on single‑source partners…exposes it to significant supply and pricing risks.

claims.claim: A judgment: Continue investing in proprietary AI infrastructure while monitoring regulatory developments, because the 10‑K notes that AI‑related legal and compliance risks could materially affect the business.
claims.quote: Artificial intelligence technologies are increasingly integrated into the Company’s products and services and its business and operations. These technologies present emerging legal, regulatory, ethical and operational risks.
